To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we built a programmable accelerator that achieves the performance and energy efficiency of a domain specific accelerator for deep neural networks.

We have designed an efficient programmable accelerator for deep neural networks that can achieve 10x to over 100x performance and energy efficiency compared to a state-of-the-art DSA for neural networks, DianNao.

“We have built an efficient specialization engine for deep neural networks that can be reprogrammed with different neural network applications and achieve 1.5x to 2.5x speedups and 3x to 4x energy savings compared to a general-purpose CPU.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
building a programmable accelerator for deep neural network applications which can be used as a platform for future domain specific accelerators.
building a programmable accelerator for a particular domain.
i) building a programmable accelerator for deep neural network domain, and ii) exploring the design space of many fine-grained design decisions for the same.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the specialization engine PENN is an area and power efficient programmable accelerator for deep neural network domain.
PENN can achieve 10x to a 100x speedup and energy efficiency compared to a general-purpose processor.
PENN is able to achieve 2.3x to 4.2x performance and 1.3x to1.7x energy benefits compared to the state-of-art neural network accelerators.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PENN can achieve 1.5x to 3x energy efficiency compared to the state-of-the art DSA DianNao.
we have designed a specialization engine that can execute deep neural networks with a performance and area that is comparable to DianNao.

, we have been able to build a complete toolchain to support PENN.
